scope: Read-only verified job-report and cost snapshots within the current authenticated owner Dashboard session
implemented: Use the actual shared report and cost dialogs with a provider scoped to the mounted owner Dashboard and environment
Retain validated successful reads in bounded memory, isolated by record kind, job ID and customer ID
Read verified snapshots on transport loss; never invent uncached reports, costs or profitability
Show read-only/freshness warnings; disable report edits and expense entry during disconnection
Require an explicit successful reload before editing after a disconnect/reconnect cycle
Reject malformed responses, mismatched report ownership and HTTP errors instead of falling back
Revoke all snapshots on observed 401/403; discard pre-save snapshots before report or cost writes
Bypass browser HTTP cache for report and expense reads; create no IndexedDB, localStorage, sessionStorage, service-worker cache or outbox

verification.finalTippingRegression: passed on isolated LIVE source with synthetic mocks only
verification.privacyChecks: No persistence writes; wrong-customer access denied; owner-session separation; auth revocation; bounded memory; cloned snapshots
verification.writeSafetyChecks: No automatic writes during disconnect/reconnect; uncertain save cannot resurrect pre-save snapshot

notCompleted: Persistent encrypted job-document storage and local unlock
Offline cold launch or browser-restart recovery of reports/costs
Offline report drafts, conflict-aware synchronization or expense/payment outboxes
Native iPhone/iPad or hosted QA acceptance
deployment: None; no hosted database, customer record, secret, payment provider or protected deployment modified
nextBatch: Integrate job-document snapshots with the existing encrypted vault/unlock lifecycle, then verify offline restart and account/target isolation before enabling durable offline records
